problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate shipments into identical cargo planes for an urgent relief mission. The shipments are as follows:

* Shipment Alpha: mass 62 metric tons
* Shipment Beta: mass 48 metric tons
* Shipment Gamma: mass 57 metric tons
* Shipment Delta: mass 48 metric tons
* Shipment Epsilon: mass 59 metric tons
* Shipment Zeta: mass 60 metric tons
* Shipment Eta: mass 69 metric tons
* Shipment Theta: mass 66 metric tons
* Shipment Iota: mass 56 metric tons
* Shipment Kappa: mass 43 metric tons
* Shipment Lambda: mass 43 metric tons
* Shipment Mu: mass 30 metric tons
* Shipment Nu: mass 43 metric tons
* Shipment Xi: mass 53 metric tons
* Shipment Omicron: mass 40 metric tons
* Shipment Pi: mass 49 metric tons
* Shipment Rho: mass 43 metric tons
* Shipment Sigma: mass 32 metric tons
* Shipment Tau: mass 65 metric tons
* Shipment Upsilon: mass 57 metric tons
* Shipment Phi: mass 56 metric tons
* Shipment Chi: mass 64 metric tons
* Shipment Psi: mass 51 metric tons
* Shipment Omega: mass 43 metric tons
* Shipment A1: mass 38 metric tons
* Shipment B1: mass 48 metric tons
* Shipment C1: mass 35 metric tons
* Shipment D1: mass 38 metric tons
* Shipment E1: mass 33 metric tons
* Shipment F1: mass 51 metric tons
* Shipment G1: mass 33 metric tons
* Shipment H1: mass 38 metric tons
* Shipment I1: mass 34 metric tons
* Shipment J1: mass 63 metric tons
* Shipment K1: mass 37 metric tons
* Shipment L1: mass 37 metric tons
* Shipment M1: mass 33 metric tons
* Shipment N1: mass 37 metric tons
* Shipment O1: mass 39 metric tons
* Shipment P1: mass 54 metric tons

Each cargo plane has a maximum payload capacity of 100 metric tons. The coordinator must assign all shipments to planes, ensuring each shipment is placed on exactly one plane and the total mass on any plane does not surpass its capacity. The objective is to utilize the smallest possible number of planes to complete the airlift.
